impact.summary: Orders API error rate increased and refund queue depth rose sharply.

hypotheses.statement: The new orders-api deployment changed refund publication behavior, increasing queue load and causing request failures.
predicted_observations: Queue growth begins after the deployment.
The changed code path publishes more refund requests per cancellation.
disconfirming_observations: Queue growth began before the deployment.
The deployed diff does not affect refund publication behavior.

uncertainties: The exact start time of queue saturation is sampled at one-minute intervals.

findings: Test whether the deploy changed the refund publication count per request.
